column2: Why is evidence-based medicine not the same as obeying an evidence hierarchy?
column3: It integrates the best research with clinical expertise, patient values, biology, resources, and context, because research only estimates effects under uncertainty and clinicians must judge validity, importance, applicability, and fit with the patient's goals.
